title: Talbina
attribution: Recipe adapted from Food Fusion (foodfusion.com). Not an official Food Fusion product.

steps.instruction: -In a bowl add barley and water. Then wash it thoroughly and strain.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ek bowl mein jau ka dalia aur paani dalain. Phir achi tarah dhokar chaan lain.

steps.instruction: -Add fresh water, cover & soak barley for 3-4 hours or overnight.
steps.romanUrdu: -Taaza paani dalain, dhak kar 3-4 ghantay ya raat bhar bhigo dain.

steps.instruction: -In a cooking pot add milk, and bring it to boil.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ek cooking pot mein doodh dalain aur boil anay dain.

steps.instruction: -Now strain the soaked barley and add in boiling milk.
steps.romanUrdu: -Ab bhigoe hue jau ko chaan kar ubalte huay doodh mein daal dain.

steps.instruction: -Mix, half cover and cook on low flame for 30-40 minutes. Stir in between.
steps.romanUrdu: -Mix karain, aadha dhak kar halki aanch par 30–40-minute pakain, beech beech mein chammach chalain.

steps.instruction: -Remove the cover, mix again, add cinnamon powder and green cardamom powder. Then mix it.
steps.romanUrdu: -Dhakkan hata kar dobara mix karain, darchini powder aur hari ilaichi powder shamil karain, phir achi tarah mix karain.

steps.instruction: -If the consistency is thick, add milk again to maintain it.
steps.romanUrdu: -Agar mixture zyada ghara ho jaye, to thoda doodh aur dal kar consistency maintain karain.

steps.instruction: -Cover & cook on low flame for 10-12 minutes.
-Turn off the flame,add honey & mix well.
steps.romanUrdu: -Chulha bund ker dein aur shehad dal kar mix karain.

steps.instruction: -In a serving dish add talbina. Give a finishing touch with honey, dates, pistachios, and almonds.
steps.romanUrdu: -Serving dish mein talbina dalain aur upar se shehad, khajoor, pista aur badam se sajain.

ogDescription: One of the healthiest recipes you can enjoy this Ramadan! Our beloved Prophet (PBUH) regularly consumed Talbina, a simple yet incredibly wholesome dish.
